metadata.description: Claude Code mods by Pu-Sung Chang. They draw in the band above the prompt and spend zero model tokens.

plugins.name: nba-scores-mod
plugins.description: Live NBA scores above the Claude Code prompt, in the terminal and the desktop app. Pick your team and its games come first; in the desktop app it also gets its own totem and team color. Open any game for the score by quarter and top scorers. Spoiler-free mode hides final scores until you ask. English and Traditional Chinese. Data from ESPN's public endpoints, no key and no account. Zero model tokens.
